text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the Japan Cup. Manhattan Cafe 
looked back on the rivals she had raced, 
guided by her "friend."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week,
who drew strength from food. 
Silence Suzuka, who hid a fiery passion 
deep inside. These were the sources of 
their running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then,
what kind of strength does Zenno Rob 
Roy possess? To that question, Zenno Rob 
Roy herself answered, "An unyielding 
spirit."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Guided by her "friend," fragments of
power 
gather within Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At this "Japan Cup," everything might
just 
fall into place.
